//: TEMPLATE — install.ps1 merges these keys into the recipient's ~/.claude/settings.json.
//paths: __CLAUDE_DIR__ is rewritten by install.ps1 to the recipient's actual ~/.claude path.
//merge: DECISION OPEN (README #2): merge-vs-prompt per key. These are the keys we touch.
//hooks: Only present if the SessionStart/Stop hooks ship via bootstrap instead of the plugin (README #1). If the plugin carries them, omit this block entirely.
//auto-update: Declares the kit's OWN marketplace so a recipient auto-installs AND auto-updates it at startup. Third-party marketplaces are NOT auto-update by default, so a declarative entry with autoUpdate:true is the only way to make updates seamless. Merged add-if-absent (Merge-SettingsJson deep-merges these two object keys); never clobbers a recipient's existing marketplaces/plugins. The marketplace is named 'claude-squidmode' (matches the repo) and the plugin is 'dimitri-claude-kit', so the plugin ref is plugin@marketplace = 'dimitri-claude-kit@claude-squidmode'. This key MUST match the 'name' in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, which is what 'claude plugin marketplace add' registers the marketplace under.
//external-plugins: The OPTIONAL enhancement plugins (andrej-karpathy-skills, code-simplifier) are still installed imperatively by install.ps1's Install-ExternalPlugins; they are not declared here.
